definitions: The act of consuming a large quantity of negative online news or social media content, especially on a mobile device, to the detriment of one's mental well-being.
The tendency to continue to surf or scroll through bad news, even though that news is saddening, disheartening, or depressing.
examples: My doomscrolling habit is getting out of control.
She spent hours in a state of doomscrolling.
The pandemic led to an increase in doomscrolling.
